prompt: Number the rows inside each group_id, highest committed_offset first (ROW_NUMBER() OVER PARTITION BY ... ORDER BY ...), aliased rn.
template:
-- EXPECTED: [["analytics", "orders", 210], ["archive", "audit", 10], ["billing", "orders", 200], ["fraud", "orders", 80], ["zeta", "orders", 40]]

-- Tables are loaded for you: partitions(topic, partition_id, log_end_offset) and commits(group_id, topic, partition_id, committed_offset).
SELECT group_id, topic, committed_offset FROM (
  SELECT group_id, topic, committed_offset,
         @@BLANK@@
  FROM commits
)
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY group_id;
answer: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY group_id ORDER BY committed_offset DESC) AS rn
why: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ... ORDER BY ...) numbers rows within each group, highest offset first.
